# Soothly AI - AI Context

> This file provides context for AI assistants working on this codebase.
> Last updated: 2026-01-23

## 1. The Mission

Soothly AI is an "Autonomous Revenue Platform" - not a CRUD app.

**Core Promise:** 8 AI Agents working 24/7 to automate revenue operations.
**Philosophy:** Every feature must reduce user friction ("Soothly AI").

## 2. The Technology Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|:------|:-----------|
| Framework | Next.js 16 (App Router) + TypeScript |
| Database | Supabase (PostgreSQL) with RLS |
| Vector Store | Supabase pgvector |
| Auth | Supabase Auth |
| Orchestration | Inngest (Durable Workflows) |
| Styling | Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui |
| Validation | Zod (mandatory for all inputs) |
| Forms | react-hook-form + zodResolver |
| State | React Query (server) + Zustand (client) |
| Default AI Model | gemini-3-flash |

## 3. The 8-Agent Ecosystem

| Agent | Role | Trigger Pattern |
|:------|:-----|:----------------|
| Lead Gen | The Hunter | `agent.leads.*` |
| SEO | The Publisher | `agent.seo.*` |
| Partnership | The Connector | `agent.partnership.*` |
| Proposal | The Closer | `agent.proposal.*` |
| Competitor Intel | The Spy | `agent.intel.*` |
| Revenue Recovery | The Collector | `agent.revenue.*` |
| Onboarding | The Guide | `agent.onboarding.*` |
| Customer Success | The Advocate | `agent.success.*` |
| **Superagent** | The Manager | `agent.superagent.*` |

**Architecture:** Hub-and-Spoke. Superagent orchestrates, never executes directly.

## 4. Critical Constraints

### DO
- Use Inngest `step.run()` for all AI calls (durability)
- Enforce RLS on every table
- Validate all inputs with Zod
- Use Server Components for data fetching
- Use `sonner` for toast notifications
- Check pricing-strategy.md before implementing usage/billing logic

### DON'T
- Call AI providers directly in Route Handlers (timeout risk)
- Use `service_role` in API routes handling user data
- Create public landing pages (out of scope)
- Use mock data in production code
- Expose 3rd party API keys to client

## 6. Key Directories

```
src/
├── agents/           # Agent implementations (prompts, types, memory)
├── app/
│   ├── (platform)/   # Protected routes (dashboard, settings)
│   ├── (auth)/       # Login, signup
│   └── api/          # Route handlers
├── components/       # UI components
├── inngest/          # Durable workflow functions
├── lib/              # Shared utilities (supabase, ai, auth)
└── types/            # TypeScript definitions
```

## 7. Important Patterns

### Durable AI Pattern
```typescript
// Always wrap AI calls in step.run()
const result = await step.run("generate-content", async () => {
  return ai.generate({ prompt: ... });
});
```

### Human-in-the-Loop
```typescript
// Pause for approval when needed
await step.waitForEvent("approval", {
  event: "app/approval.received",
  timeout: "7d",
});
```

### 3-Tier Autonomy
- `manual`: Ask after every step
- `smart`: Ask only if unsure (default)
- `auto`: Full autopilot

## 8. Brand Identity

- **Colors:** Obsidian (#080808), Violet (#9382FF)
- **Fonts:** Host Grotesk (headings), Manrope (body), JetBrains Mono (code)
- **Style:** Dark Glassmorphism, no shadows (use glows)
